main_topics.reason: The user came overwhelmed by conflicting food lists and asked how to follow the diet, including whether it means permanent restriction.
The user asked how to test foods and whether reintroduction should be done with professional support, then included it in their plan.
The user asked whether an NHS dietitian referral for IBS would be covered and decided to ask their GP.
The user worried that elimination would leave them starving or eating only plain rice and sought reassurance about eating varied meals.
The user described feeling overwhelmed and later panicked by the food lists, then said they felt less panicked and reassured.

output.summary: The user was overwhelmed by conflicting low-FODMAP food lists and worried the diet meant giving up foods permanently or eating very little. The assistant explained the phases, suggested the Monash app and asking a GP about a dietitian referral, and described reintroduction and meal options; the user summarized an accepted plan and said the conversation was genuinely helpful.
